title: Thomas Edison: Inventor and Busy Team Leader (1/2)
titleZh: 湯瑪斯・愛迪生：發明家與忙碌的團隊領導者 (1/2)
summaryZh: 介紹愛迪生的成長與發明，以及他如何帶領團隊不斷創新。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — As It Is

sentences.text: The inventor Thomas Alva Edison had a major effect on the lives of people around the world.
sentences.zh: 發明家湯瑪斯・阿爾瓦・愛迪生對全世界人們的生活有很大的影響。

sentences.text: Thomas Edison is remembered most for the electric light, his phonograph, and his work with motion pictures.
sentences.zh: 大家最記得愛迪生的，是電燈、留聲機，還有他在電影方面的貢獻。

sentences.text: Edison was born on February 11, 1847, in Milan, Ohio.
sentences.zh: 愛迪生在1847年2月11日出生於俄亥俄州的米蘭鎮。
他的知識大多是自學來的。

sentences.text: His mother taught him reading, writing, and mathematics.
sentences.zh: 他的母親教他讀書、寫字和算數。

sentences.text: He learned from books, and he experimented.
sentences.zh: 他從書本上學習，也自己動手做實驗。

sentences.text: At the age of ten, he experimented with chemicals and electricity.
sentences.zh: 十歲的時候，他就開始做化學和電的實驗。

sentences.text: He built a telegraph machine, and, at the age of sixteen, he went to work as a telegraph operator.
sentences.zh: 他自己做了一台電報機，十六歲就去當電報員了。

sentences.text: He continued his work with electricity, making improved telegraph machines, and he invented an electrical voting machine.
sentences.zh: 他持續研究電，改良電報機，還發明了一台電動投票機。

sentences.text: Edison earned enough money from his early inventions to start his own company in 1871. Instead of working alone,
sentences.zh: 愛迪生靠早期的發明賺到足夠的錢，在1871年開了自己的公司。他沒有單打獨鬥，

sentences.text: he worked with a group of employees on many different projects at one time.
sentences.zh: 而是和一群員工同時進行很多不同的專案。

sentences.text: They asked the United States government for patents to protect more than one hundred devices or inventions each year.
sentences.zh: 他們每年都向美國政府申請專利，保護超過一百項裝置或發明。

sentences.text: He was an extremely busy man.
In 1913, a popular magazine called Thomas Edison the most useful man in America.
sentences.zh: 1913年，一本很受歡迎的雜誌稱愛迪生是全美國最有用的人。

sentences.text: He almost never slept more than four or five hours a night.
sentences.zh: 他每天晚上幾乎從來沒有睡超過四、五個小時。
